visualDirection.name: 暖白克制
visualDirection.contrastCheck: All text tokens on bg/surface/sunken and each status color on its soft fill ≥ 4.5:1 in both themes (lowest: light ink3 on sunken 4.74, light ink3 on accentSoft 4.76). Computed with the WCAG relative-luminance formula; not checked in a browser.
visualDirection.type: Inter + -apple-system/PingFang TC/Noto Sans TC; UI 13px, long-form 16px with 1.85 line height and 680px measure; SF Mono for paths and hashes
visualDirection.icons: inline stroke SVG drawn for this prototype (1.8 stroke, round caps); no library chosen yet
visualDirection.motion: 150ms hover/toggle transitions, skeleton pulse 1.2s, spinner 0.8s; all disabled under prefers-reduced-motion

adjustmentsFromBrief: Scope reduced to the 8 Mac boards per the 2026-11-16 Mac-first decision; mobile boards removed from the canvas.
Sidebar footer shows service and Agent API status instead of iPhone/iPad connection.
Settings drops Tailscale and device pairing (phase 2) and adds 備份／還原 (phase-1 production-ready requirement).
Conflict board reframed for phase 1: this window's edits vs a version an external editor wrote to disk.
Added onAccent token: dark accent #8EA2FF is light, so primary-button text must be dark (#161615, 7.56:1) instead of white.
Added scrim token per theme for dialogs.
Diffs use strikethrough/underline as well as color, so deletions and insertions do not rely on red/green hue alone.
Partial adoption is per-change checkboxes (DESIGN.md requires 採用／部分採用／捨棄); the brief listed only 採用／插入／重試／捨棄.
Restoring a revision or undoing an AI change creates a new revision instead of rewriting history.
Platform simulations use fixed neutral platform-like backgrounds, not the app theme.
keyboard: Visible focus ring on every control (2px accent, 2px offset).

Shortcuts declared with aria-keyshortcuts: ⌘F search, ⌘N new, ⌘/ visual/source, ⌘P preview, ⌘↩ adopt and esc discard inside the AI panel, ⌘Z undo. Only the AI panel keys are wired in the prototype (scoped onKeyDown; the canvas forbids global key handlers).
Text inputs that act on Enter ignore Enter while an IME is composing.

references.borrowed: Selected paragraph stays highlighted in the editor while the panel shows the suggestion; apply/insert/retry grouped under the result.
references.adaptation: Right-side panel next to the article with keyboard shortcuts; undo bar after applying; history shares the same panel slot.

references.borrowed: One change per row so each can be judged on its own.
references.adaptation: Each AI change is a checkbox row (delete line + insert line) enabling partial adoption; conflict merge uses the same per-change rows.

references.borrowed: Controls on the left, rendered preview on the right before anything leaves the app.
references.adaptation: Per-platform version fields on the left, phone-frame simulation on the right, labeled 模擬, no platform logos.

references.borrowed: Warm white ground, dark ink, sparse blue; hierarchy from size and spacing rather than decoration.
references.adaptation: Applied to the whole shell; color comes from work covers.

references.borrowed: Token-only colors, fixed radius set, 4px spacing, copy reduction.
references.adaptation: Every color is a CSS variable switched by the dark Tweak; strings kept to labels and short states.

references.borrowed: Pick the waiting pattern per operation; failures retry in place.
references.adaptation: Skeletons for library, assets and AI generation; progress bars for imports and video upload; spinner chips for service start and backup; inline retry on failed saves, imports and analysis.

verified: Static checks on all 8 artboard sources: tag balance (HTML parser), script syntax (node --check), data-props JSON parse — all pass.
notVerified: NOT_VERIFIED: rendering in the live canvas — user chose to review the canvas directly (2026-11-16).
NOT_VERIFIED: interactions and Tweak switching (dark, narrow, state) — user chose to review the canvas directly (2026-11-16).
NOT_VERIFIED: measured contrast in the rendered page (formula check only) — user chose to review the canvas directly (2026-11-16).
NOT_VERIFIED: keyboard Tab order and VoiceOver — user chose to review the canvas directly (2026-11-16).
Not done: recycle-bin flow, upload and URL dialogs, key entry dialog, model switch menu in the AI panel; image placeholders are color blocks.
openQuestions: Software name and logo are placeholders (qiu-creator, ink square).
待發布 status and primary actions share the accent color; consider a separate status hue.

decisions: Sidebar: 232 default, 200 min, 320 max, 56 collapsed rail; drag the right edge, double-click resets, ←/→ on the focused handle adjust by 16px; ⌃⌘S toggles. Groups 創作／素材／AI; 設定 pinned bottom-left; 發布中心 not shown.
Service dot next to the app name: green when service, realtime updates and Agent API are all healthy; red if any fails. Details on hover or keyboard focus.
Asset delete: managed files go to 最近刪除 for 30 days (restore re-links references); external files default to remove-from-library only, moving the original to the system Trash is an explicit opt-in.
Unreferenced managed assets delete without a dialog and offer undo; referenced ones confirm with the work list.
Asset edit fields: display name (disk file name unchanged), tags, alt text, note.
Batch: recommend multi-select with batch tag and batch remove now; batch rename deferred.
Editor insert: toolbar menu, slash command, right-side asset drawer (tab beside AI), drag from drawer or Finder, ⌘V paste uploads to the library then inserts.
Settings: left category nav with in-page anchors; grouped inset lists; theme cards apply instantly.
backendNeeds: PATCH /api/v1/assets/:id — display_name, tags, alt, note (new fields).
DELETE /api/v1/assets/:id — managed: move to trash with deleted_at; external: unindex, optional move_original_to_system_trash flag.
GET /api/v1/assets?scope=trash, POST /api/v1/assets/:id/restore, DELETE /api/v1/trash/:id and DELETE /api/v1/trash (permanent, 30-day purge job).
Paste and Finder drop reuse the existing upload API; insert returns an asset reference for the Markdown link.
